integrity: The universal inequality and equality cases are proved analytically by Parseval, an exact cubic self-convolution expansion, a monotone symmetrization, and a one-variable factorization. The bundled computation is corroborative only.
limitations: Only the analytic quadratic space \(\operatorname{span}\{1,z,z^2\}\), equivalently a three-term arithmetic progression of integer frequencies, is treated.
No claim is made for other exponents, higher degree, or non-arithmetic three-frequency supports.
Arestov's 1980 different-metrics paper was not available as directly inspectable full text; an equivalent hidden low-degree special case remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact \(L^2\)-to-\(L^6\) Nikolskii constant for analytic quadratics
